name: io.github.brainfish-ai/webcrawl
title: Webcrawl Anything
description: Scrape, map, crawl, search and monitor the web. Runs locally with no API key, cites every source.

environmentVariables.name: WEBCRAWL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave unset to run fully local. Set a webcrawl.app key to use the hosted cloud.

environmentVariables.name: WEBCRAWL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: local, cloud or auto. Default auto runs local unless an API key is set.

environmentVariables.name: WEBCRAWL_MCP_SCHEMA_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Set to compact for smaller tool schemas in context-limited clients.
